description: This file defines a custom OpenLayers layer class 'ChartLayer' that renders interactive charts at geographic locations on a map, using React components and OpenLayers transformations.

classes.name: ChartLayer
classes.description: A custom map layer that displays charts at specific geographic locations, managing chart creation, updates, and rendering within an OpenLayers map.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a ChartLayer with options, setting up internal state, loading spinner, and event handlers.

methods.name: setChartConfig
methods.description: Updates the chart configuration and triggers a re-render if not silent.

methods.name: setChartVizType
methods.description: Sets the visualization type for charts and triggers a re-render if not silent.

methods.name: setChartSizeValues
methods.description: Updates chart size values and triggers a re-render if not silent.

methods.name: setChartBackgroundCssColor
methods.description: Sets the background color for charts and triggers a re-render if not silent.

methods.name: setChartBackgroundBorderRadius
methods.description: Sets the border radius for chart backgrounds and triggers a re-render if not silent.

methods.name: removeAllChartElements
methods.description: Removes all chart DOM elements and unmounts React components.

methods.name: createCharts
methods.description: Creates chart React components for each feature at a given zoom level.

methods.name: updateCharts
methods.description: Updates existing charts if size changes for a given zoom level.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the charts on the map, positioning them based on map state, and shows a loading mask during animations.
